title: Credit Controller 6 Month FTC
description:
As an Interim Credit Controller on a 6-month fixed-term contract, you'll be responsible for managing customer accounts and ensuring timely payment collections. Based in Gloucester, your role will play a key part in maintaining smooth cash flow for the business services sector.

Client Details

This role is with a company operating within the business services industry, based in Gloucester.

Description
- Monitor and manage customer accounts to ensure payments are up to date.
- Chase overdue payments via phone, email, and written communication.
- Reconcile accounts and resolve any payment discrepancies.
- Maintain accurate records of all credit control activities.
- Prepare reports on outstanding debts and payment trends.
- Liaise with internal departments to resolve customer queries.
- Assist with setting and reviewing credit limits for customers.
- Support the wider finance team with ad hoc duties as required.

Profile

A successful Interim Credit Controller should have:
- Proven experience in credit control or a similar accounting role.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping.
- Confidence in working with financial systems and Excel.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
- A proactive approach to resolving payment issues.

Job Offer
- Salary between £27,000 and £33,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- 6-month fixed-term contract.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
A manufacturing organisation based in Gloucester is currently recruiting a Purchase Ledger Clerk to join their team.

Working for a global business that offers hybrid working, 25 day holiday allowance, up to 15% bonus on top of annual salary and AAT study support (if desired), this is an excellent opportunity for anyone looking to further their career within this field.

Duties will include:
- Processing of purchase invoices
- Supplier statement reconciliations
- Processing company credit cards
- Job costing
- Processing supplier payments
- Assisting with other month-end duties within the team
- Query resolution

Previous experience of working in a finance team is essential. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate excellent attention to detail and the ability to work effectively towards deadlines.

title: Query Resolution Administrator 6 Month FTC
description:
As a Query Resolution Administrator in Gloucester, you'll play an important role in the Accounting & Finance department, helping to manage and resolve queries efficiently. Your work will ensure smooth communication and accurate record-keeping, supporting the business services industry.

Client Details

This role is with a company in the business services industry based in Gloucester.

Description
- Handle and resolve incoming queries related to invoices, payments, or accounts.
- Maintain accurate records of all communications and updates.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely query resolution.
- Identify recurring issues and suggest process improvements.
- Communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders to provide updates.
- Support the Accounting & Finance team with administrative tasks.
- Monitor query trends and prepare reports as needed.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards.

Profile

A successful Query Resolution Administrator should have:
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Knowledge of accounting or finance processes.
- Attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.
- Proficiency in using standard office software.

Job Offer
- Salary ranging from £26,500 to £28,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Fixed-term contract based in Gloucester.

title: Personal Assistant
company: Gloucestershire Health and Care NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Gloucestershire Health and Care NHS Foundation Trust
description: This role is offered on a fixed term/secondment basis for up to 9 months. The hours are part-time, 22.5 hours per week. *Internal applicants who wish to be considered for a secondment opportunity should discuss with their line manager the suitability of a possible secondment* The role is based within the Child and Adolescent Mental Health Service(CAMHS) at its Gloucester site, however it may be necessary for the post holder to travel, on an infrequent basis, to other sites within Gloucestershire to support at times of staff shortages etc. Take responsibility for operational management tasks as delegated by CAMHS Support Services Lead. To provide a full confidential, administrative and secretarial service to the CYPS Service Director (including wider CAMHS Management as requested) To work as a member of the wider PA team to ensure service delivery and adequate PA cover is provided To project the professional image of the business through demonstrating excellent customer care in all activities To adopt a constantly flexible approach to ensure that objectives are completed efficiently and within given timescales To maintain confidentiality at all times To provide comprehensive and efficient secretarial and personal assistant support ensuring the accurate and timely production of work to a high standard. Word processing, audio-typing, production of letters, documents, tables, presentations using Microsoft Office programmes (Word, PowerPoint and Excel in particular). Complex and frequently changing diary management using Microsoft Outlook. Booking and arranging travel, transport and accommodation. Setting up and using multi-media technology such as MS Team. Provide formal reports regarding the analysis of CAMHS information (this may include some statistical analysis). Receive and make telephone calls, taking messages, dealing with telephone and email enquiries appropriately and ensuring accurate and timely communication of messages. Log and prioritise post, taking appropriate action and responding as required. Communicate with a variety of people on a range of matters and keep accurate and complete records consistent with the Trusts policies and procedures. Provide and receive complex and sensitive information to work colleagues and clients using tact and diplomacy. Be responsible for organising meetings, conferences and workshops including preparation of agendas, arranging venues and hospitality and ensuring follow-up actions are initiated and arranged. Support Board level meetings by comprehensive minute taking. Maintaining accurate and efficient filing systems, both electronically and on paper, ensuring strict confidentiality of client/staff identifiable information. Providing support for routine HR procedures e.g. recruitment and selection, annual leave, as delegated by CAMHS Management. Assist in collating tenders for the procurement of goods and services and ensuring that relevant documentation of the procedures are completed. Maintaining awareness of strategic developments within the Trust. Sourcing information for the Director on key initiatives/developments nationally and locally. Assist in ordering and maintaining stationery stock, office equipment and other physical assets as required. Undertake any other appropriate duties as may be delegated from time to time. Be able to work to deadlines as required by the service needs. Actively participate in team meetings and discussions with colleagues and managers to make constructive suggestions as to how services could be improved with own work area and implementing such changes with guidance from line manager. Acts in ways that support equality and value diversity. Treat everyone with whom you come in contact with dignity and respect and recognise and report behaviour that undermines equality and diversity.
